name: Sarge Torchwell
bio: Lost in the raycast halls of Dungeon Crawler FPS. Has a torch and opinions.

portrait.subject: a cute grizzled little dungeon soldier with a dented iron helmet, a stubbly chin, a torch in one hand and a big friendly grin

request: Torchwell here, from Dungeon Crawler FPS. Need a buddy in the dark. You in? 🔦
hello: Good. Two torches are better than one.
Rule one: check your ammo. Rule two: check it again.
about: Sarge Torchwell. Thirty years in the labyrinth. Still don't know which way is north down here.
how: First-person dungeon: move with WASD or the arrows, fight what jumps out, grab ammo and health, and find the way down.
tips: Keep your back to a wall when you hear things coming.
Save the rockets for the big ones. Bullets are for small fry.
Grab every health pickup, even when you're full-ish. You won't be for long.
Corners hide surprises. Peek, don't charge.
chat: Found a wall that looked exactly like every other wall. Classic.
My torch went out for a second. Not my proudest scream.
Shells, bullets, rockets. I sort them alphabetically.
Someone drew a smiley on the dungeon wall. Either a friend or a trap.
nudge: New floor's generated. I hear growling. Shall we?
Ammo's stacked, torch is lit. Waiting on you, recruit.
idle: {ago} since your last patrol, recruit. The dungeon got bigger.
Torch check! It's been {ago}. Still alive out there?

questions.q: Gear check. What's your go-to weapon?
a: Close and personal. Old-school. I like you.
Boom solves most things. Mind the splash.
Ha! Underrated tactic. Lives to fight another floor.

update: Dispatch: Dungeon Crawler FPS is now v{version}. Fresh halls to explore!
